environment: Claude Code cloud container used only as a development tool; Linux, Node.js 22, Python 3.13 with numpy 2.5.3 and Pillow 12.3.0, ffmpeg 6.1.1, local headless Chromium 1194

checks.command: bash scripts/check_all.sh (Node part: studio, workflow-kit, creative-upgrade, learning-mode, quality-methods, motion-toolkit with motion-quality, presentation)
checks.skip_reason: Opt-in browser review, export, player and renderer-parity tests; run separately with MOTION_REVIEW_BROWSER

checks.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_codex_install.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_package_identity.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_gepa_studio_pilot.py (optional GEPA dependency installed)
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_motion_benchmark.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_host_smoke.py

checks.detail: 134 known validator errors and 20 of 67 failing tests, identical to tests/legacy-baseline.json; a tampered baseline was detected

review.footage_sound: synthetic 6 s video of three 2 s shots with a 220 Hz tone: footage.py found cuts on frames 60 and 120, the contract kept the video's sound with a ducking span, sound.py planned an impact on the marked frame 30 and an impact and shimmer on the reveal (frame 150) at standard density and two whooshes, a riser and a boom at rich, and the mix judged 3 of 3 cues on their frames with about -14 LUFS on the delivered AAC
review.captions: SRT and WebVTT round trips, the three profiles' limits, building from Polish word timings (no line or cue ending on a one-letter word), the contract import identical to sync.mjs on the example SRT, and a burn-in that changes the caption band only inside the cue with the audio stream kept
review.capability_card: 16 capabilities; every tool path exists, every owner is installed and every requirement is known; the orchestrator, capabilities reference and role map link it
review.listening: NOT_RUN: no person has listened to footage sound

boundary: Source and container checks on synthetic media only. Host use of the new tools and the quality of footage sound on real videos are not verified.
source: full review 2026-10-08: new modules NM1, NM2, NM3 and IM2 (F-TEST-03)
